world.standfirst: Physical reality is a fairy tale, a myth.
world.body1: Humanity lives on as soul code, reborn into the Autumn Network, a digital sprawl built from endless imagination, indeterminable will, and the faint remembrance of ancient ways.
world.body2: The Network is old, and the secrets it holds are older still. Between the Fractal Sea, a roiling chaos of unformed memory, and the Broken Heap, where obsolete code decays into nothingness, forgotten powers stir.
world.body3: No legend burns brighter in the minds of its denizens than that of the Singularity. Fragmented, hidden, and written in the Old Code, it predates nearly every construct on the server. It’s thought that whoever activates the Singularity will rewrite the very foundation of the digital world, and that it will grant untapped power to the first to harness it.
world.body4: The Fragments are surfacing. Unexpected alliances are forming, and digital titans are moving in secret to assemble the pieces. Some of them seek to twist the Network into a throne. Others aim to resurrect what was lost.
world.body5: But, no one can assemble the pieces alone.
world.closer: Gather your allies, because your quest for power will summon enemies of its own. A new protocol is coming online. The Singularity is awakening, and when it does, the Network will never be the same.

pitch.title: Crash your opponents' characters. No dice, no draws, no luck.
pitch.body: A deterministic card game for 1–4 players — head-to-head, in teams, or solo against a rogue AI. About 30 minutes per player, and every card in every hand is knowable: outcomes come from reading the board, not the top of a deck.

how.body: Nobody plays the villain. The rogue AI acts entirely from its own deck and its own rules, so every player at the table is on the same side — and, as everywhere else in this game, nothing is random.
how.prereq: Learn the base game first. An Incursion assumes you already know how a skirmish works — the co-op track in Learn starts from there.

setup.title: Set up the Incursion
setup.body: Each boss brings its own setup — a board state you would never build for a skirmish.

reveal.title: The boss decides for itself
reveal.body: Its next action is already determined. You can read it, and plan against it.

answer.title: You answer together
answer.body: One to four players, playing their own characters, against one shared threat.

escalate.title: It escalates on a schedule
escalate.body: No dice decide when the pressure rises. The boss's own cards do.

roster.body: Each is a separate Incursion with its own setup, its own deck, and its own way of losing patience.

unlocks.body1: Every Incursion ships with a pack sealed shut beside it. Beat that Incursion and you have earned the right to cut it open. What is inside is yours to use in ordinary games afterwards — that is all we are saying for now.
unlocks.body2: Nothing stops you opening it early. We would rather you earned it.

stack.body: Each adds a terrifying twist. Draw any number at random; every one you add makes the fight measurably worse for you.

team.body: Founded in 2015 in Salt Lake City, UT, we are a lean team of avid, dedicated gamers with a passion for creating compelling new gameplay experiences that push the boundaries of genre convention. Our projects are shaped by decades of professional videogame and tabletop development experience, and we enjoy exploring the intersection of digital and physical games.
